+
+msgid "# Hy4-preview (Experimental)"
+msgstr "# Hy4-preview（实验性）"
+
+msgid "## 1 Introduction"
+msgstr "## 1 简介"
+
+msgid ""
+"**Hy4 Preview** is a next-generation flagship Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model"
+" developed by the Tencent Hy Team. The model has a total of **770B** "
+"parameters, with approximately **49B** parameters activated per token."
+msgstr ""
+"**Hy4 Preview** "
+"是腾讯Hy团队开发的下一代旗舰级混合专家（MoE）模型。该模型总参数量为**770B**，每个token约激活**49B**参数。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The model backbone contains **78 layers**: the first layer adopts a standard"
+" Dense FFN, and the remaining **77 layers all adopt the MoE structure**. "
+"Each MoE layer contains **256 Routed Experts** and **1 Shared Expert**. For "
+"each token, the model selects the **Top-8** experts from the 256 routed "
+"experts for computation, while always activating the shared expert."
+msgstr ""
+"模型主干包含**78层**：第一层采用标准Dense "
+"FFN，其余**77层均采用MoE结构**。每个MoE层包含**256个路由专家**和**1个共享专家**。对于每个token，模型从256个路由专家中选择**Top-8**个专家进行计算，同时始终激活共享专家。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In addition to the backbone, the model also has **1 native MTP (Multi-Token "
+"Prediction) layer** built in to support speculative decoding. The MTP layer "
+"has a total of about **10B** parameters, with about **0.7B** parameters "
+"activated per token."
+msgstr ""
+"除主干外，模型还内置**1个原生MTP（多token预测）层**以支持投机解码。MTP层总参数量约为**10B**，每个token约激活**0.7B**参数。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This document describes how to quickly get started with Hy4 model inference "
+"deployment on Ascend NPU using vLLM-Ascend, based on W8A8 quantized weights."
+msgstr "本文档介绍如何使用vLLM-Ascend在昇腾NPU上基于W8A8量化权重快速部署Hy4模型推理。"
+
+msgid "**Current status and constraints**"
+msgstr "**当前状态与限制**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Hy4 Preview is provided **out-of-the-box** through the official Docker image `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:hy4`. The supporting code has **not yet been merged** into the vLLM-Ascend repository, so installing it from source (`pip install` or building from source) is **not supported** for this model yet.\n"
+"    - Only **Atlas 800I A3 (A3)** is supported now. Other Ascend hardware (e.g., Atlas 800I A2) is not supported for Hy4 Preview.\n"
+"    - The features listed in [Supported Features](#2-supported-features) are only those enabled by the verified deployment commands in this document, and do **not** imply that all features are supported for Hy4 Preview. This is an early-access version; performance optimization and reliability validation are still in progress (see [Declaration](#9-declaration))."
+msgstr ""
+"- Hy4 Preview通过官方Docker镜像`quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:hy4`**开箱即用**。相关支持代码**尚未合并**到vLLM-Ascend仓库中，因此目前**不支持**通过源码安装（`pip install`或从源码构建）此模型。\n"
+"    - 目前仅支持**Atlas 800I A3（A3）**。其他昇腾硬件（如Atlas 800I A2）不支持Hy4 Preview。\n"
+"    - [支持特性](#2-supported-features)中列出的特性仅为本文档中已验证部署命令所启用的特性，**不**意味着所有特性均支持Hy4 Preview。此为早期访问版本，性能优化和可靠性验证仍在进行中（参见[声明](#9-declaration)）。"
+
+msgid "## 2 Supported Features"
+msgstr "## 2 支持的特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to [Supported Features "
+"List](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md) to get the "
+"model's supported feature matrix."
+msgstr ""
+"请参阅[支持特性列表](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md)获取模型的支持特性矩阵。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to [Feature Guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md) to get the"
+" feature's configuration."
+msgstr "请参阅[特性指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md)获取特性的配置方法。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The features below are the ones enabled by the verified deployment commands "
+"in [Chapter 5](#5-online-service-deployment)."
+msgstr "以下特性为[第5章](#5-online-service-deployment)中已验证部署命令所启用的特性。"
+
+msgid "| Feature | Description | Configuration |"
+msgstr "| 特性 | 描述 | 配置 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Tensor Parallel (TP) | Splits the model across all 16 NPUs within a node. "
+"| `--tensor-parallel-size 16` |"
+msgstr "| 张量并行（TP） | 将模型拆分到节点内的全部16个NPU上。 | `--tensor-parallel-size 16` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Expert Parallel (EP) | Distributes the MoE experts (256 routed + 1 shared "
+"per layer) across NPUs. | `--enable-expert-parallel` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 专家并行（EP） | 将MoE专家（每层256个路由专家+1个共享专家）分布到各NPU上。 | `--enable-expert-parallel`"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Data Parallel (DP) | Multi-node DP across 2 nodes, extending the context "
+"to 96K. | `--data-parallel-size 2` |"
+msgstr "| 数据并行（DP） | 跨2个节点的多节点DP，将上下文扩展到96K。 | `--data-parallel-size 2` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| W8A8 Quantization | Loads the W8A8 quantized weights (Ascend "
+"quantization). | `--quantization ascend` |"
+msgstr "| W8A8量化 | 加载W8A8量化权重（昇腾量化）。 | `--quantization ascend` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Automatic Prefix Caching | Reuses the KV cache for shared prompt prefixes."
+" | `--enable-prefix-caching` |"
+msgstr "| 自动前缀缓存 | 为共享的提示词前缀复用KV缓存。 | `--enable-prefix-caching` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Speculative Decoding (MTP) | Uses the native MTP layer for Multi-Token "
+"Prediction. | `--speculative-config '{\"method\": \"mtp\", "
+"\"num_speculative_tokens\": 3}'` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 投机解码（MTP） | 使用原生MTP层进行多token预测。 | `--speculative-config '{\"method\": "
+"\"mtp\", \"num_speculative_tokens\": 3}'` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Decode Graph Capture | Captures the decode phase into a graph to reduce "
+"kernel launch overhead. | `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": "
+"\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 解码图捕获 | 将解码阶段捕获为图以减少内核启动开销。 | `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": "
+"\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| NPUGraph EX | Ascend-specific graph execution optimization. | "
+"`--additional-config '{\"ascend_compilation_config\": "
+"{\"enable_npugraph_ex\": true}}'` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| NPUGraph EX | 昇腾特有的图执行优化。 | `--additional-config "
+"'{\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\": true}}'` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"> **Note:** The features listed above are the ones enabled in the verified "
+"deployment commands in this document. Other features, such as LoRA, Pipeline"
+" Parallel, and Prefill-Decode Disaggregation, are not verified in this "
+"document."
+msgstr ""
+"> **注意：** 上述列出的特性为本文档中已验证部署命令所启用的特性。其他特性，如LoRA、流水线并行和Prefill-"
+"Decode分离，未在本文档中验证。"
+
+msgid "## 3 Prerequisites"
+msgstr "## 3 前提条件"
+
+msgid "### 3.1 Model Weight"
+msgstr "### 3.1 模型权重"
+
+msgid "| Model | Weight |"
+msgstr "| 模型 | 权重 |"
+
+msgid "| Hy4-preview | <https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-preview> |"
+msgstr "| Hy4-preview | <https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-preview> |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Hy4-preview-w8a8 | <https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-"
+"Tech/Hy4-preview-w8a8> |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Hy4-preview-w8a8 | <https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-"
+"Tech/Hy4-preview-w8a8> |"
+
+msgid ""
+"This document uses the quantized "
+"[Hy4-preview-w8a8](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-"
+"Tech/Hy4-preview-w8a8) weights, which are about 762 GB. Download the weights"
+" to the local disk."
+msgstr ""
+"本文档使用量化的[Hy4-preview-w8a8](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-"
+"Tech/Hy4-preview-w8a8)权重，大小约为762 GB。请将权重下载到本地磁盘。"
+
+msgid "### 3.2 Hardware and Software Preparation"
+msgstr "### 3.2 硬件和软件准备"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Hardware | Ascend HDK | CANN version | torch_npu version | vLLM | vLLM-"
+"Ascend version |"
+msgstr "| 硬件 | Ascend HDK | CANN版本 | torch_npu版本 | vLLM | vLLM-Ascend版本 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Atlas 800I A3 (A3) | 25.5.0 (recommended) | CANN 9.0.1 | 2.10.0.post2 | "
+"Based on v0.23.0 | Based on v0.23.0 |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Atlas 800I A3（A3） | 25.5.0（推荐） | CANN 9.0.1 | 2.10.0.post2 | 基于v0.23.0 | "
+"基于v0.23.0 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Hy4 Preview currently supports **only the Atlas 800I A3 (A3)** hardware; "
+"other Ascend hardware (e.g., Atlas 800I A2) is not supported."
+msgstr "Hy4 Preview目前**仅支持Atlas 800I A3（A3）**硬件；其他昇腾硬件（如Atlas 800I A2）不受支持。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Before getting started, confirm that the firmware/driver is installed "
+"correctly. The recommended HDK version is 25.5.0. Run the following command "
+"to confirm; the version shown in the output header is the HDK version."
+msgstr "开始之前，请确认固件/驱动已正确安装。推荐的HDK版本为25.5.0。运行以下命令进行确认；输出头部显示的版本即为HDK版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Because the weights are large, a single A3 node only supports about 1K "
+"context. If you need to test long sequences such as 32K, it is recommended "
+"to use 2 A3 nodes."
+msgstr "由于权重较大，单个A3节点仅支持约1K上下文。如果需要测试32K等长序列，建议使用2个A3节点。"
+
+msgid "### 3.3 Verify Multi-node Communication (Optional)"
+msgstr "### 3.3 验证多节点通信（可选）"
+
+msgid ""
+"If you want to deploy a multi-node environment, you need to verify multi-"
+"node communication according to [verify multi-node communication "
+"environment](../../installation.md#verify-multi-node-communication)."
+msgstr ""
+"如果要部署多节点环境，需要按照[验证多节点通信环境](../../installation.md#verify-multi-node-"
+"communication)进行多节点通信验证。"
+
+msgid "## 4 Installation"
+msgstr "## 4 安装"
+
+msgid "### 4.1 Docker Image Installation"
+msgstr "### 4.1 Docker镜像安装"
+
+msgid "#### Download Docker Image"
+msgstr "#### 下载Docker镜像"
+
+msgid "After a successful download, check the existing images:"
+msgstr "下载成功后，检查现有镜像："
+
+msgid ""
+"The output should contain the downloaded `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:hy4`."
+msgstr "输出中应包含已下载的`quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:hy4`。"
+
+msgid "#### Create Docker Container"
+msgstr "#### 创建Docker容器"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the following command to create the container. The Atlas 800I A3 is a "
+"16-card device, so you need to mount `/dev/davinci[0-15]` and the management"
+" devices. Also mount the driver library and the weight directory (this guide"
+" assumes the weights are stored on the host at `/mnt/weight` and mounted to "
+"the same path inside the container)."
+msgstr ""
+"使用以下命令创建容器。Atlas 800I A3 是16卡设备，因此需要挂载 `/dev/davinci[0-15]` "
+"和管理设备。同时挂载驱动库和权重目录（本指南假设权重存储在宿主机 `/mnt/weight` 路径下，并挂载到容器内的相同路径）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The `-v` option maps directories. **You should map the weight directory into"
+" the container** so that the weights can be accessed inside the container. "
+"The local weight path is `/mnt/weight`; modify it according to the actual "
+"situation."
+msgstr ""
+"`-v` 选项用于映射目录。**您应将权重目录映射到容器中**，以便在容器内访问权重。本地权重路径为 "
+"`/mnt/weight`；请根据实际情况进行修改。"
+
+msgid "Enter the container interactive environment:"
+msgstr "进入容器交互环境："
+
+msgid "### 4.2 Source Code Installation"
+msgstr "### 4.2 源码安装"
+
+msgid ""
+"Hy4 Preview is currently provided **out-of-the-box** via the "
+"`quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:hy4` Docker image. Because the supporting code "
+"has **not yet been merged** into the vLLM-Ascend repository, source-code "
+"installation is **not supported** for this model yet; please use the Docker "
+"image as described in [4.1 Docker Image Installation](#41-docker-image-"
+"installation)."
+msgstr ""
+"Hy4 Preview 目前通过 `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:hy4` Docker "
+"镜像**开箱即用**。由于相关支持代码**尚未合并**到 vLLM-Ascend 仓库中，该模型目前**不支持**源码安装；请按照 [4.1 "
+"Docker 镜像安装](#41-docker-image-installation) 中的说明使用 Docker 镜像。"
+
+msgid "## 5 Online Service Deployment"
+msgstr "## 5 在线服务部署"
+
+msgid "### 5.1 Single-Node Online Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.1 单节点在线部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"A3 single-node TP=16 full-card inference is suitable for validation and low-"
+"concurrency short-sequence scenarios. Execute the following after entering "
+"the container interactive environment:"
+msgstr "A3 单节点 TP=16 全卡推理适用于验证和低并发短序列场景。进入容器交互环境后执行以下操作："
+
+msgid "### 5.2 Multi-Node Co-Located Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.2 多节点协同部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"DP=2 cross-machine deployment with TP=16 per node extends the context to "

+"Node 2 (Node2, demo IP `192.168.1.2`) is a headless worker. Both nodes share"

+
+msgid "Startup order:"
+msgstr "启动顺序："

+"2. After seeing the `Started DP Coordinator process` log, execute the corresponding script in the container on Node 2;\n"

+msgstr ""
+"1. 首先在节点1的容器中执行以下脚本（rank 0，包括 API）；\n"
+"2. 看到 `Started DP Coordinator process` 日志后，在节点2的容器中执行相应的脚本；\n"
+"3. 大约20分钟后，看到 `Application startup complete` 表示服务已就绪。启动时间与权重的磁盘读写速度等因素有关。"
+

+msgstr "**节点1脚本：**"
+
+msgid "**Node 2 script:**"
+msgstr "**节点2脚本：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"> Note: `--data-parallel-address` is set to the local IP (i.e., the "

+msgstr ""

+
+msgid ""
+"Because the weights are large, the load time is related to the disk read "
+"speed, and the first load usually takes about 10 minutes. The following logs"
+" indicate that the service has been started successfully:"
+msgstr "由于权重较大，加载时间与磁盘读取速度相关，首次加载通常需要约10分钟。以下日志表示服务已成功启动："
+

+msgid "# Kimi-K3"
+msgstr "# Kimi-K3"
+
+msgid "## 1 Introduction"
+msgstr "## 1 简介"
+
+msgid ""
+"Kimi-K3 is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model that combines Kimi Delta\n"
+"Attention (KDA), gated Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), attention residuals,\n"
+"SiTU activations, and latent MoE layers."
+msgstr ""
+"Kimi-K3 是一个多模态专家混合模型，结合了 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)、门控多头潜在注意力 "
+"(MLA)、注意力残差、SiTU 激活函数和潜在 MoE 层。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This tutorial covers model preparation, installation, online serving, and\n"
+"accuracy and performance evaluation for the full W4A8 checkpoint on Atlas A3.\n"
+"This tutorial is based on **vLLM-Ascend main with vLLM 0.27.1**. Use a\n"
+"main-branch build with Kimi-K3 support and its matching vLLM revision."
+msgstr ""
+"本教程涵盖 Atlas A3 上完整 W4A8 检查点的模型准备、安装、在线服务和精度与性能评估。本教程基于 **vLLM-Ascend main "
+"分支及 vLLM 0.27.1**。请使用支持 Kimi-K3 的 main 分支构建及其匹配的 vLLM 版本。"
+
+msgid "## 2 Supported Features"
+msgstr "## 2 支持的特性"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to the [Supported Models](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md)\n"
+"for the model support matrix and the\n"
+"[Feature Guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md) for feature configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"有关模型支持矩阵，请参阅[支持的模型](../../user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md)；有关功能配置，请参阅[功能指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/index.md)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This guide covers A3 W4A8 text and multimodal serving, TP/DP/EP, Prefix Cache,\n"
+"`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph, and DSpark with a matching draft checkpoint."
+msgstr ""
+"本指南涵盖 A3 W4A8 文本和多模态服务、TP/DP/EP、前缀缓存、`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL 图，以及使用匹配草稿检查点的 "
+"DSpark。"
+
+msgid "## 3 Prerequisites"
+msgstr "## 3 前提条件"
+
+msgid "### 3.1 Model Weights and Hardware"
+msgstr "### 3.1 模型权重和硬件"
+
+msgid "| Model | Download | Purpose | Requirements |"
+msgstr "| 模型 | 下载 | 用途 | 要求 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Eco-Tech/Kimi-K3-w4a8 | [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-"
+"Tech/Kimi-K3-w4a8) | Full 93-layer, 896-expert W4A8 target | About 1.49 TB "
+"of weight storage; the reference deployment uses four Atlas 800 A3 nodes "
+"with 16 logical NPUs per node (DP4/TP16/EP64) |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Eco-Tech/Kimi-K3-w4a8 | [ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Eco-"
+"Tech/Kimi-K3-w4a8) | 完整的 93 层、896 专家 W4A8 目标 | 约需 1.49 TB 权重存储空间；参考部署使用四个 "
+"Atlas 800 A3 节点，每个节点 16 个逻辑 NPU（DP4/TP16/EP64） |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark | "
+"[ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark) / "
+"[Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark) | Optional "
+"GQA draft | Set `num_speculative_tokens` to `7` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark | "
+"[ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark) / "
+"[Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark) | 可选的 GQA 草稿 "
+"| 将 `num_speculative_tokens` 设置为 `7` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark | "
+"[ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark) / "
+"[Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark) | Optional "
+"MLA draft | Set `num_speculative_tokens` to `7` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark | "
+"[ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark) / "
+"[Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark) | 可选的 MLA 草稿 "
+"| 将 `num_speculative_tokens` 设置为 `7` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-Block5 | "
+"[ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-"
+"Block5) / [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-"
+"Block5) | Optional MLA draft with five-token blocks | Set "
+"`num_speculative_tokens` to `5` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-Block5 | "
+"[ModelScope](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-"
+"Block5) / [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-"
+"Block5) | 可选的 MLA 草稿，使用五 token 块 | 将 `num_speculative_tokens` 设置为 `5` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Download weights, tokenizer, and processor files before starting the service.\n"
+"Mount them at identical paths on every node, for example under `/path/to/models`.\n"
+"The weight size is a storage requirement, not an estimate of runtime NPU memory;\n"
+"KV cache, activations, communication buffers, and the optional draft also need\n"
+"memory."
+msgstr ""
+"在启动服务前，请下载权重、分词器和处理器文件。将它们挂载到每个节点的相同路径下，例如 `/path/to/models`。权重大小是存储需求，而非运行时"
+" NPU 内存的估算值；KV 缓存、激活、通信缓冲区以及可选的草稿模型也需要内存。"
+
+msgid "### 3.2 Verify Multi-Node Communication"
+msgstr "### 3.2 验证多节点通信"
+
+msgid ""
+"Before launching the four-node service, follow\n"
+"[Verify Multi-Node Communication](../../installation.md#verify-multi-node-communication).\n"
+"Use a reachable address and the correct communication interface on each node.\n"
+"All nodes must use the same model revision and compatible software stack."
+msgstr ""
+"在启动四节点服务之前，请按照[验证多节点通信](../../installation.md#verify-multi-node-"
+"communication)进行操作。在每个节点上使用可达的地址和正确的通信接口。所有节点必须使用相同的模型版本和兼容的软件栈。"
+
+msgid "## 4 Installation"
+msgstr "## 4 安装"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Kimi-K3 installation and deployment instructions in this tutorial apply\n"
+"only to the Atlas A3 series."
+msgstr "本教程中的 Kimi-K3 安装和部署说明仅适用于 Atlas A3 系列。"
+
+msgid "### 4.1 Docker Image Installation"
+msgstr "### 4.1 Docker 镜像安装"
+
+msgid ""
+"Follow the [installation requirements](../../installation.md#requirements) for\n"
+"the host driver and firmware. Start the A3 container below on every node."
+msgstr ""
+"请按照[安装要求](../../installation.md#requirements)配置主机驱动和固件。在每个节点上启动以下 A3 容器。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The example uses the main-branch nightly image for the vLLM 0.27-based stack.\n"
+"Check that the image includes Kimi-K3 support and the matching vLLM version.\n"
+"Pin its digest for reproducible deployments.\n"
+"To build an image from the selected source revision, follow Section 4.2."
+msgstr ""
+"该示例使用 main 分支的 nightly 镜像，适用于基于 vLLM 0.27 的软件栈。请确认镜像包含 Kimi-K3 支持和匹配的 vLLM "
+"版本。固定其 digest 以确保部署的可复现性。要从选定的源码版本构建镜像，请按照第 4.2 节操作。"
+
+msgid "Verify the installed revisions before starting the service:"
+msgstr "在启动服务前，请验证已安装的版本："
+
+msgid "### 4.2 Source Code Installation"
+msgstr "### 4.2 源码安装"
+
+msgid ""
+"To build the A3 image from source, run the following on an A3 build host.\n"
+"The Dockerfile installs the matching CANN/PyTorch/TorchNPU stack and compiles\n"
+"the Ascend operators; `VLLM_COMMIT` selects the upstream revision verified for\n"
+"the chosen vLLM-Ascend checkout."
+msgstr ""
+"要在 A3 构建主机上从源码构建镜像，请运行以下命令。Dockerfile 会安装匹配的 CANN/PyTorch/TorchNPU 软件栈并编译 "
+"Ascend 算子；`VLLM_COMMIT` 选择针对所选 vLLM-Ascend 检出已验证的上游版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the resulting image on every node with the container command in Section 4.1,\n"
+"replacing its `IMAGE` value. Record the source revision and image digest.\n"
+"For an installation outside Docker, follow the\n"
+"[source installation guide](../../installation.md#set-up-using-python), using\n"
+"the selected main checkout and its verified vLLM commit instead of the older\n"
+"release versions in the generic examples."
+msgstr ""
+"在每个节点上使用生成的镜像，并采用第 4.1 节中的容器命令，替换其中的 `IMAGE` 值。记录源码版本和镜像 digest。如需在 Docker "
+"之外安装，请按照[源码安装指南](../../installation.md#set-up-using-python)，使用选定的 main "
+"分支检出及其已验证的 vLLM 提交，而不是通用示例中的旧版本。"
+
+msgid "## 5 Online Service Deployment"
+msgstr "## 5 在线服务部署"
+
+msgid "### 5.1 Four-Node Online Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.1 四节点在线部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"The full checkpoint uses four Atlas 800 A3 nodes in a DP4/TP16/EP64 mixed\n"
+"deployment. Start Node 0 first. Each worker owns one global DP rank and joins\n"
+"Node 0 through the DP RPC address."
+msgstr ""
+"完整检查点使用四个 Atlas 800 A3 节点，采用 DP4/TP16/EP64 混合部署。首先启动节点 0。每个 worker 拥有一个全局 DP"
+" rank，并通过 DP RPC 地址加入节点 0。"
+
+msgid "Set these variables on every node:"
+msgstr "在每个节点上设置以下变量："
+
+msgid "Run on Node 0:"
+msgstr "在节点 0 上运行："
+
+msgid ""
+"Run on Nodes 1 through 3. Set `DP_START_RANK` to 1, 2, or 3 respectively:"
+msgstr "在节点 1 到 3 上运行。分别将 `DP_START_RANK` 设置为 1、2 或 3："
+
+msgid "Key parameter descriptions:"
+msgstr "关键参数说明："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 4` and `--data-parallel-size-local 1` create one DP\n"
+"  rank per node. `--tensor-parallel-size 16` uses all 16 local logical NPUs;\n"
+"  `--enable-expert-parallel` distributes experts across the 64-rank EP group.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-start-rank` identifies each worker's global DP rank.\n"
+"  `--headless` workers join Node 0 without serving a separate HTTP endpoint.\n"
+"- `--max-model-len` bounds input plus output tokens;\n"
+"  `--max-num-batched-tokens` bounds tokens scheduled per iteration, and\n"
+"  `--max-num-seqs` bounds concurrent sequences per engine.\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` controls the model executor's device-memory\n"
+"  budget. Check capacity with the actual checkpoint before increasing sequence\n"
+"  length, concurrency, or adding a draft.\n"
+"- `--tokenizer-mode kimi_k3`, `--reasoning-parser kimi_k3`, and\n"
+"  `--tool-call-parser kimi_k3` select the Kimi-K3 request/response format.\n"
+"  `--enable-auto-tool-choice` enables automatic tool selection.\n"
+"- `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` captures decode execution; `--enable-prefix-caching`\n"
+"  enables reuse of cached prefixes."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 4` 和 `--data-parallel-size-local 1` 在每个节点上创建一个DP\n"
+"  等级。`--tensor-parallel-size 16` 使用全部16个本地逻辑NPU；\n"
+"  `--enable-expert-parallel` 将专家分布到64等级的EP组中。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-start-rank` 标识每个工作进程的全局DP等级。\n"
+"  `--headless` 工作进程加入节点0，而不提供单独的HTTP端点。\n"
+"- `--max-model-len` 限制输入加输出令牌数；\n"
+"  `--max-num-batched-tokens` 限制每次迭代调度的令牌数，\n"
+"  `--max-num-seqs` 限制每个引擎的并发序列数。\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` 控制模型执行器的设备内存\n"
+"  预算。在增加序列长度、并发性或添加草稿之前，请使用实际检查点检查容量。\n"
+"- `--tokenizer-mode kimi_k3`、`--reasoning-parser kimi_k3` 和\n"
+"  `--tool-call-parser kimi_k3` 选择Kimi-K3请求/响应格式。\n"
+"  `--enable-auto-tool-choice` 启用自动工具选择。\n"
+"- `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 捕获解码执行；`--enable-prefix-caching`\n"
+"  启用缓存前缀的复用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Wait for all ranks to finish weight loading and graph compilation before\n"
+"running the request in Section 6. For general startup issues, see the\n"
+"[Public FAQ](../../faqs.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"等待所有等级完成权重加载和图编译，然后再运行第6节中的请求。对于一般的启动问题，请参阅\n"
+"[公共FAQ](../../faqs.md)。"
+
+msgid "### 5.2 Speculative Decoding with DSpark"
+msgstr "### 5.2 使用DSpark进行推测解码"
+
+msgid ""
+"Choose a GQA or MLA draft from the [model weights](#31-model-weights-and-hardware)\n"
+"listed in Section 3.1 and download it to the same path on every node.\n"
+"The following configuration uses seven speculative tokens for\n"
+"`RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark` or `Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark`. For\n"
+"`Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-Block5`, select that checkpoint's path and change\n"
+"`num_speculative_tokens` to `5`."
+msgstr ""
+"从第3.1节列出的[模型权重](#31-model-weights-and-hardware)中选择一个GQA或MLA草稿，\n"
+"并将其下载到每个节点上的相同路径。\n"
+"以下配置对`RadixArk/Kimi-K3-DSpark`或`Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark`使用七个推测令牌。对于\n"
+"`Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-Block5`，选择该检查点的路径并将\n"
+"`num_speculative_tokens`更改为`5`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Add the same speculative configuration to the Node 0 and headless worker "
+"commands:"
+msgstr "将相同的推测配置添加到节点0和无头工作进程命令中："
+
+msgid ""
+"The example proposes seven draft tokens in one query block, followed by\n"
+"target-model verification.\n"
+"Set `draft_tensor_parallel_size` to the topology used to shard the draft model."
+msgstr ""
+"该示例在一个查询块中提出七个草稿令牌，随后进行\n"
+"目标模型验证。\n"
+"将`draft_tensor_parallel_size`设置为用于分片草稿模型的拓扑。"
+
+msgid "## 6 Functional Verification"
+msgstr "## 6 功能验证"
+
+msgid ""
+"Once all four nodes have completed model loading and graph compilation, send\n"
+"a request to the Node 0 service from a host in the serving network."
+msgstr ""
+"一旦所有四个节点完成模型加载和图编译，从服务网络中的主机向节点0服务发送\n"
+"请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Expected result: HTTP 200 with a JSON response containing a non-null choice and\n"
+"generated text. Generation may stop before `max_tokens` when a stop token is\n"
+"reached."
+msgstr ""
+"预期结果：HTTP 200，JSON响应包含非空的choice和\n"
+"生成的文本。当达到停止令牌时，生成可能会在`max_tokens`之前停止。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a multimodal smoke test, replace the message content with an image and a\n"
+"text instruction:"
+msgstr ""
+"对于多模态冒烟测试，将消息内容替换为图像和\n"
+"文本指令："
+
+msgid ""
+"For automatic tool selection, keep `--enable-auto-tool-choice` and\n"
+"`--tool-call-parser kimi_k3` in the startup command and include `tools` and\n"
+"`tool_choice: \"auto\"` in the chat request."
+msgstr ""
+"对于自动工具选择，在启动命令中保留`--enable-auto-tool-choice`和\n"
+"`--tool-call-parser kimi_k3`，并在聊天请求中包含`tools`和\n"
+"`tool_choice: \"auto\"`。"
+
+msgid "## 7 Accuracy Evaluation"
+msgstr "## 7 精度评估"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the full 93-layer, 896-expert checkpoint with the four-node service in\n"
+"Section 5.1."
+msgstr "使用第5.1节中的四节点服务，使用完整的93层、896专家检查点。"
+
+msgid "### Using AISBench"
+msgstr "### 使用AISBench"
+
+msgid ""
+"Follow [Using AISBench](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md) to\n"
+"configure the `kimi-k3` chat-completions endpoint and run GPQA. Keep the model\n"
+"and tokenizer revisions, chat rendering, reasoning mode, sampling parameters,\n"
+"dataset, and evaluator revisions fixed when comparing results. Record completed,\n"
+"failed, missing, and unparsed samples alongside the score."
+msgstr ""
+"按照[使用AISBench](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md)配置\n"
+"`kimi-k3`聊天补全端点并运行GPQA。在比较结果时，保持模型\n"
+"和分词器修订版、聊天渲染、推理模式、采样参数、\n"
+"数据集和评估器修订版固定。记录已完成、\n"
+"失败、缺失和未解析的样本以及分数。"
+
+msgid "### Using Language Model Evaluation Harness"
+msgstr "### 使用语言模型评估工具"
+
+msgid ""
+"See [Using lm_eval](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_lm_eval.md) for\n"
+"evaluator setup. Use the same full checkpoint and serving configuration when\n"
+"comparing results across backends."
+msgstr ""
+"有关评估器设置，请参阅[使用lm_eval](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_lm_eval.md)。\n"
+"在跨后端比较结果时，使用相同的完整检查点和服务配置。"
+
+msgid "## 8 Performance Evaluation"
+msgstr "## 8 性能评估"
+
+msgid "### Using AISBench"
+msgstr "### 使用AISBench"
+
+msgid ""
+"Refer to [AISBench performance evaluation](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md#execute-performance-evaluation)\n"
+"for configuration and execution instructions."
+msgstr ""
+"有关配置和执行说明，请参阅[AISBench性能评估](../../developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.md#execute-"
+"performance-evaluation)。"
+
+msgid "### Using vLLM Benchmark"
+msgstr "### 使用vLLM基准测试"
+
+msgid ""
+"After the service in Section 5.1 is ready, run the following from a load generator\n"
+"in the serving network with the same vLLM version and tokenizer files. Set\n"
+"`NODE0_IP` and `TOKENIZER_PATH` to the service address and local tokenizer path."
+msgstr ""
+"在第5.1节中的服务就绪后，从服务网络中的负载生成器运行以下命令，\n"
+"使用相同的vLLM版本和分词器文件。将\n"
+"`NODE0_IP`和`TOKENIZER_PATH`设置为服务地址和本地分词器路径。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This example measures 100 requests with at most four in flight, using random\n"
+"1024-token inputs and 128-token outputs. The chat format can add input tokens;\n"
+"`--ignore-eos` prevents early EOS from shortening the requested output length.\n"
+"`--request-rate inf` sends requests as soon as concurrency slots are available.\n"
+"Check that all 100 measured requests succeed and review throughput, TTFT, and\n"
+"TPOT in the console and saved JSON results. Adjust lengths and concurrency for\n"
+"the intended workload; this example is not a peak-performance configuration.\n"
+"See the [vLLM benchmark tools](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/)\n"
+"for additional options."
+msgstr ""
+"此示例测量100个请求，最多四个并发，使用随机\n"
+"1024令牌输入和128令牌输出。聊天格式可以增加输入令牌；\n"
+"`--ignore-eos`防止早期EOS缩短请求的输出长度。\n"
+"`--request-rate inf`在并发槽可用时立即发送请求。\n"
+"检查所有100个测量的请求是否成功，并在控制台和保存的JSON结果中查看吞吐量、TTFT和\n"
+"TPOT。根据预期工作负载调整长度和并发性；此示例不是峰值性能配置。\n"
+"有关其他选项，请参阅[vLLM基准测试工具](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Record the checkpoint revision, topology, graph mode, Prefix Cache setting,\n"
+"input/output lengths, concurrency, completed requests, and error count together\n"
+"with throughput and latency. Report cold-prefix and prefix-hit workloads\n"
+"separately. With DSpark, also record the draft checkpoint and speculative-token\n"
+"count."
+msgstr ""
+"记录检查点修订版、拓扑、图模式、前缀缓存设置、\n"
+"输入/输出长度、并发性、完成的请求和错误计数，以及\n"
+"吞吐量和延迟。分别报告冷前缀和前缀命中工作负载。\n"
+"使用DSpark时，还要记录草稿检查点和推测令牌\n"
+"计数。"
+
+msgid "## 9 Performance Tuning"
+msgstr "## 9 性能调优"
+
+msgid "### 9.1 Reference Configuration"
+msgstr "### 9.1 参考配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following is the configuration used by the full-checkpoint commands above,\n"
+"not a claim of optimal throughput or latency for every workload."
+msgstr ""
+"以下是上述完整检查点命令使用的配置，\n"
+"并非声称对每个工作负载都是最优吞吐量或延迟。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Deployment | Nodes | Total logical NPUs | TP per DP rank | Global DP / EP "
+"| Max Num Seqs per Engine | Max Num Batched Tokens | Max Model Len | Graph "
+"Mode |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 部署 | 节点 | 逻辑NPU总数 | 每个DP等级的TP | 全局DP / EP | 每个引擎的最大序列数 | 最大批量令牌数 | 最大模型长度 "
+"| 图模式 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Optional DSpark uses draft TP16 and draft `max_model_len=4096`, as shown in\n"
+"Section 5.2. Use seven speculative tokens for the RadixArk GQA draft or the\n"
+"Inferact seven-token MLA draft, and five for `Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-Block5`.\n"
+"Account for its extra memory before enabling it."
+msgstr ""
+"可选的DSpark使用草稿TP16和草稿`max_model_len=4096`，如\n"
+"第5.2节所示。对RadixArk GQA草稿或\n"
+"Inferact七令牌MLA草稿使用七个推测令牌，对`Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark-Block5`使用五个。\n"
+"在启用之前考虑其额外内存。"
+
+msgid "### 9.2 Tuning Guidelines"
+msgstr "### 9.2 调优指南"
+
+msgid "| Goal | Parameters to evaluate | Check before adopting a change |"
+msgstr "| 目标 | 需要评估的参数 | 采用更改前需检查的内容 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Higher throughput | Increase `--max-num-seqs` or `--max-num-batched-"
+"tokens` gradually | Memory headroom, completed requests, and tail latency |"
+msgstr ""

+"- `--dtype float16` specifies the data type for model weights and computations.\n"
+"- `--trust-remote-code` allows loading models with custom code.\n"
+"- `--enforce-eager` forces the use of eager execution mode instead of graph compilation, which can be more stable for some models.\n"
+"- `--block-size` specifies the block size for KV cache management, with a value of `128` used here.\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` sets the proportion of NPU memory to use for the model, with a value of `0.7` used here to reduce memory usage."
+msgstr ""

+"- `--max-model-len` 指定最大上下文长度，即单个请求的输入和输出令牌之和。此处为测试目的使用值 `4096`。\n"
+"- `--dtype float16` 指定模型权重和计算的数据类型。\n"
+"- `--trust-remote-code` 允许加载带有自定义代码的模型。\n"
+"- `--enforce-eager` 强制使用即时执行模式而非图编译，这对某些模型可能更稳定。\n"
+"- `--block-size` 指定KV缓存管理的块大小，此处使用值 `128`。\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置用于模型的NPU内存比例，此处使用值 `0.7` 以减少内存占用。"

+msgid ""
+"- **Prefill nodes** focus on high-throughput prompt processing, optimized for compute and communication (e.g., enabling sequence parallelism for Allreduce acceleration).\n"
+"- **Decode nodes** focus on low-latency token generation, optimized for memory bandwidth (e.g., enabling full-decode aclgraph)."
+msgstr ""
+"- **预填充节点**专注于高吞吐量的提示处理，针对计算和通信进行了优化（例如，启用序列并行以加速 Allreduce）。\n"
+"- **解码节点**专注于低延迟的 token 生成，针对内存带宽进行了优化（例如，启用全解码 aclgraph）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `recompute_scheduler_enable: true`: enables the recomputation scheduler. When the KV Cache of the decode node is insufficient, requests will be sent to the prefill node to recompute the KV Cache. In the PD separation scenario, enable this configuration only on decode nodes.\n"
+"   - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'` (on decode nodes): enables the full-decode aclgraph mode, which significantly reduces scheduling latency on the decode side."
+msgstr ""
+"- `recompute_scheduler_enable: true`：启用重计算调度器。当解码节点的 KV Cache 不足时，请求将被发送到预填充节点以重新计算 KV Cache。在 PD 分离场景中，仅在解码节点上启用此配置。\n"
+"   - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\":\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`（在解码节点上）：启用全解码 aclgraph 模式，可显著降低解码端的调度延迟。"

 msgid ""
 "- `--data-parallel-size 1` and `--tensor-parallel-size 2` are common settings for data parallelism (DP) and tensor parallelism (TP) sizes.\n"
 "    - `--max-model-len` represents the context length, which is the maximum value of the input plus output for a single request. The Qwen3.6-27B model supports up to 262144.\n"
@@ -753,7 +774,7 @@ msgid ""
 "        - (2) Decode requests are prioritized for scheduling, and prefill requests are scheduled only if there is available capacity.\n"
 "        - Generally, if `--max-num-batched-tokens` is set to a larger value, the overall latency will be lower, but the pressure on HBM memory (activation value usage) will be greater.\n"
 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Its essential function is to calculate the available kv_cache size. During the warm-up phase (referred to as profile run in vLLM), vLLM records the peak HBM memory usage during an inference process with an input size of `--max-num-batched-tokens`. The available kv_cache size is then calculated as: `--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM size - peak HBM memory usage. Therefore, the larger the value of `--gpu-memory-utilization`, the more kv_cache can be used. However, since the HBM memory usage during the warm-up phase may differ from that during actual inference (e.g., due to uneven EP load), setting `--gpu-memory-utilization` too high may lead to OOM (Out of Memory) issues during actual inference. The default value is `0.9`.\n"
-"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` indicates that prefix caching is disabled. The current implementation of hybrid kv cache for Qwen3.5-27B / Qwen3.6-27B may result in a very large effective `block_size` when prefix caching is enabled (e.g., 2048), which means any prefix shorter than `block_size` will never be cached. If your workload has many short repeated prefixes, consider keeping prefix caching disabled. For related issues, see the [Public FAQs](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html).\n"
+"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` indicates that prefix caching is disabled. The current implementation of hybrid kv cache for Qwen3.5-27B / Qwen3.6-27B may result in a very large effective `block_size` when prefix caching is enabled (e.g., 2048), which means any prefix shorter than `block_size` will never be cached. If your workload has many short repeated prefixes, consider keeping prefix caching disabled. For related issues, see the [Public FAQs](../../faqs.md).\n"
 "    - `--quantization ascend` indicates that quantization is used. To disable quantization, remove this option.\n"
 "    - `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for both `Qwen3.5-27B` and `Qwen3.6-27B` because they share the same MTP head design.\n"
 "    - `--compilation-config` contains configurations related to the aclgraph graph mode. The most significant configurations are `\"cudagraph_mode\"` and `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`, which have the following meanings:\n"
@@ -765,15 +786,15 @@ msgstr ""
 "    - `--max-num-seqs` 表示每个 DP 组允许处理的最大请求数。如果发送到服务的请求数超过此限制，多余的请求将保持等待状态，不会被调度。请注意，等待状态所花费的时间也会计入 TTFT 和 TPOT 等指标中。因此，在测试性能时，通常建议 `--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= 实际总并发数。\n"
 "    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` 表示模型在单步中可处理的最大 token 数。目前，vLLM v1 调度默认启用 ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse，这意味着：\n"
 "        - (1) 如果请求的输入长度大于 `--max-num-batched-tokens`，则会根据 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 将其分成多轮计算；\n"
-"        - (2) 解码请求优先调度，仅在有可用容量时才调度预填充请求。\n"
-"        - 通常，如果将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为较大的值，整体延迟会降低，但 HBM 内存（激活值使用）的压力会更大。\n"
-"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其本质功能是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 的推理过程中的峰值 HBM 内存使用量。可用的 kv_cache 大小计算如下：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - 峰值 HBM 内存使用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可用的 kv_cache 就越多。但是，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存使用量可能与实际推理阶段不同（例如，由于 EP 负载不均），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置过高可能会导致实际推理过程中出现 OOM（内存不足）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
-"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` 表示禁用前缀缓存。Qwen3.5-27B / Qwen3.6-27B 的混合 kv cache 当前实现可能导致在启用前缀缓存时有效的 `block_size` 非常大（例如 2048），这意味着任何短于 `block_size` 的前缀都不会被缓存。如果您的负载中有许多短重复前缀，请考虑保持禁用前缀缓存。有关相关问题，请参阅[公共常见问题](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html)。\n"
+"        - (2) Decode 请求优先调度，仅在有可用容量时才调度 prefill 请求。\n"

+"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其本质功能是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 的推理过程中的峰值 HBM 内存使用量。可用的 kv_cache 大小计算如下：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - 峰值 HBM 内存使用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。但是，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存使用量可能与实际推理阶段不同（例如，由于 EP 负载不均），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置过高可能会导致实际推理期间出现 OOM（内存不足）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
+"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` 表示禁用前缀缓存。Qwen3.5-27B / Qwen3.6-27B 的混合 kv cache 当前实现可能在启用前缀缓存时导致有效的 `block_size` 非常大（例如 2048），这意味着任何短于 `block_size` 的前缀都不会被缓存。如果您的负载有许多短重复前缀，请考虑保持禁用前缀缓存。有关相关问题，请参阅[公共常见问题](../../faqs.md)。\n"
 "    - `--quantization ascend` 表示使用量化。要禁用量化，请移除该选项。\n"
 "    - `--speculative-config` 对 `Qwen3.5-27B` 和 `Qwen3.6-27B` 都使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它们共享相同的 MTP 头设计。\n"
 "    - `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是 `\"cudagraph_mode\"` 和 `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，其含义如下：\n"
-"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子调度开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"

+"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子调度的开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"

 "        - (2) Decode requests are prioritized for scheduling, and prefill requests are scheduled only if there is available capacity.\n"
 "        - Generally, if `--max-num-batched-tokens` is set to a larger value, the overall latency will be lower, but the pressure on HBM memory (activation value usage) will be greater.\n"
 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Its essential function is to calculate the available kv_cache size. During the warm-up phase (referred to as profile run in vLLM), vLLM records the peak HBM memory usage during an inference process with an input size of `--max-num-batched-tokens`. The available kv_cache size is then calculated as: `--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM size - peak HBM memory usage. Therefore, the larger the value of `--gpu-memory-utilization`, the more kv_cache can be used. However, since the HBM memory usage during the warm-up phase may differ from that during actual inference (e.g., due to uneven EP load), setting `--gpu-memory-utilization` too high may lead to OOM (Out of Memory) issues during actual inference. The default value is `0.9`.\n"
-"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` indicates that prefix caching is disabled. The current implementation of hybrid kv cache for Qwen3.6-27B may result in a very large effective `block_size` when prefix caching is enabled (e.g., 2048), which means any prefix shorter than `block_size` will never be cached. If your workload has many short repeated prefixes, consider keeping prefix caching disabled. For related issues, see the [Public FAQs](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html).\n"

+msgstr ""
+"以下示例适用于Ascend950PR系列。量化版本需要`--quantization "
+"ascend`。在Ascend950PR上，`Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8`是当前推荐的权重；在进一步优化后，可切换到`Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8-mxfp8`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1` and `--tensor-parallel-size 1` are common settings for data parallelism (DP) and tensor parallelism (TP) sizes.\n"
+"    - `--max-model-len` represents the context length, which is the maximum value of the input plus output for a single request.\n"
+"    - `--max-num-seqs` indicates the maximum number of requests that each DP group is allowed to process. If the number of requests sent to the service exceeds this limit, the excess requests will remain in a waiting state and will not be scheduled. Note that the time spent in the waiting state is also counted in metrics such as TTFT and TPOT. Therefore, when testing performance, it is generally recommended that `--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= the actual total concurrency.\n"
+"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` represents the maximum number of tokens that the model can process in a single step. Currently, vLLM v1 scheduling enables ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse by default, which means:\n"
+"        - (1) If the input length of a request is greater than `--max-num-batched-tokens`, it will be divided into multiple rounds of computation according to `--max-num-batched-tokens`;\n"
+"        - (2) Decode requests are prioritized for scheduling, and prefill requests are scheduled only if there is available capacity.\n"
+"        - Generally, if `--max-num-batched-tokens` is set to a larger value, the overall latency will be lower, but the pressure on HBM memory (activation value usage) will be greater.\n"
+"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Its essential function is to calculate the available kv_cache size. During the warm-up phase (referred to as profile run in vLLM), vLLM records the peak HBM memory usage during an inference process with an input size of `--max-num-batched-tokens`. The available kv_cache size is then calculated as: `--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM size - peak HBM memory usage. Therefore, the larger the value of `--gpu-memory-utilization`, the more kv_cache can be used. However, since the HBM memory usage during the warm-up phase may differ from that during actual inference (e.g., due to uneven EP load), setting `--gpu-memory-utilization` too high may lead to OOM (Out of Memory) issues during actual inference. The default value is `0.9`.\n"
+"    - `--quantization ascend` indicates that quantization is used. To disable quantization, remove this option.\n"
+"    - `--enable-prefix-caching` enables automatic prefix caching.\n"
+"    - `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for `Qwen3.8-27B` because it shares the same MTP head design as `Qwen3.5-27B`.\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config` contains configurations related to the aclgraph graph mode. The most significant configurations are `\"cudagraph_mode\"` and `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`, which have the following meanings:\n"
+"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`: represents the specific graph mode. Currently, `\"PIECEWISE\"` and `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` are supported. The graph mode is mainly used to reduce the cost of operator dispatch. Currently, `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` is recommended.\n"
+"        - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`: represents different levels of graph modes. The default value is `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`. In the graph mode, the input for graphs at different levels is fixed, and inputs between levels are automatically padded to the next level. Currently, the default setting is recommended. Only in some scenarios is it necessary to set this separately to achieve optimal performance.\n"
+"    - `--additional-config '{\"enable_cpu_binding\":true}'` binds OMP threads to fixed CPU cores. On a single Ascend950PR this is the single largest lever measured: single-stream decode goes from 32 tok/s without it to 63 tok/s with it."
 msgstr ""
-"对于常见的环境、安装和通用参数问题，请参阅[公共常见问题解答](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html)。"
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1`和`--tensor-parallel-size 1`是数据并行（DP）和张量并行（TP）大小的常见设置。\n"
+"    - `--max-model-len`表示上下文长度，即单个请求的输入加输出的最大值。\n"
+"    - `--max-num-seqs`表示每个DP组允许处理的最大请求数。如果发送到服务的请求数超过此限制，多余的请求将保持等待状态，不会被调度。请注意，等待状态的时间也会计入TTFT和TPOT等指标中。因此，在测试性能时，通常建议`--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= 实际总并发数。\n"
+"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens`表示模型在单步中可处理的最大token数。目前，vLLM v1调度默认启用ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse，这意味着：\n"
+"        - (1) 如果请求的输入长度大于`--max-num-batched-tokens`，将根据`--max-num-batched-tokens`将其分为多轮计算；\n"
+"        - (2) 解码请求优先调度，仅在有可用容量时才调度预填充请求。\n"
+"        - 通常，如果`--max-num-batched-tokens`设置得较大，整体延迟会较低，但对HBM内存（激活值使用）的压力会更大。\n"
+"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization`表示vLLM将用于实际推理的HBM比例。其基本功能是计算可用的kv_cache大小。在预热阶段（vLLM中称为profile run），vLLM记录输入大小为`--max-num-batched-tokens`的推理过程中的峰值HBM内存使用量。然后，可用的kv_cache大小计算为：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM大小 - 峰值HBM内存使用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization`的值越大，可使用的kv_cache就越多。然而，由于预热阶段的HBM内存使用量可能与实际推理期间不同（例如，由于EP负载不均），将`--gpu-memory-utilization`设置得过高可能导致实际推理期间出现OOM（内存不足）问题。默认值为`0.9`。\n"
+"    - `--quantization ascend`表示使用量化。要禁用量化，请移除该选项。\n"
+"    - `--enable-prefix-caching`启用自动前缀缓存。\n"
+"    - `--speculative-config`对`Qwen3.8-27B`使用`qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它与`Qwen3.5-27B`共享相同的MTP头设计。\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config`包含与aclgraph图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是`\"cudagraph_mode\"`和`\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，其含义如下：\n"
+"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持`\"PIECEWISE\"`和`\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子调度的开销。目前推荐使用`\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"
+"        - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：表示不同级别的图模式。默认值为`[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`。在图模式下，不同级别图的输入是固定的，级别之间的输入会自动填充到下一级别。目前推荐使用默认设置。仅在部分场景下需要单独设置以获得最佳性能。\n"
+"    - `--additional-config '{\"enable_cpu_binding\":true}'`将OMP线程绑定到固定的CPU核心。在单个Ascend950PR上，这是测量到的最大性能提升手段：单流解码从无此配置时的32 tok/s提升到有此配置时的63 tok/s。"
+

+msgid "# Score Encoder Cache Manager"
+msgstr "# Score编码器缓存管理器"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Score encoder cache manager uses a CPU cache tier and a score-based policy\n"
+"to manage multimodal encoder outputs. Selecting the manager enables the feature;\n"
+"there is no separate `enabled` option."
+msgstr ""
+"Score编码器缓存管理器使用CPU缓存层和基于分数的策略来管理多模态编码器输出。选择该管理器即启用此功能；没有单独的`enabled`选项。"
+
+msgid "## Online inference"
+msgstr "## 在线推理"
+
+msgid "## Offline inference"
+msgstr "## 离线推理"
+
+msgid "## Configuration options"
+msgstr "## 配置选项"
+
+msgid "| Name | Type | Default | Description |"
+msgstr "| 名称 | 类型 | 默认值 | 描述 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `cpu_cache_slots` | int | `100000` | Maximum CPU cache capacity in encoder"
+" embedding slots. |"
+msgstr "| `cpu_cache_slots` | int | `100000` | CPU缓存的最大容量，以编码器嵌入槽位为单位。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `max_clock` | int | `15` | Maximum clock value used by the aging policy. |"
+msgstr "| `max_clock` | int | `15` | 老化策略使用的最大时钟值。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `clock_decay_every` | int | `64` | Number of requests between clock decay "
+"steps. |"
+msgstr "| `clock_decay_every` | int | `64` | 两次时钟衰减步骤之间的请求数。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `watermark` | float | `0.2` | Target ratio of NPU cache slots to keep free"
+" after eviction. |"
+msgstr "| `watermark` | float | `0.2` | 驱逐后保持空闲的NPU缓存槽位目标比例。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `promote_percentile` | float | `0.2` | Score percentile threshold used to "
+"promote CPU entries to NPU. |"
+msgstr "| `promote_percentile` | float | `0.2` | 用于将CPU条目提升至NPU的分数百分位阈值。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Custom managers are selected by fully qualified class name. Each manager defines\n"
+"its own `manager_config` schema and consumes it through `create_manager`."
+msgstr ""
+"自定义管理器通过完全限定的类名进行选择。每个管理器定义自己的`manager_config`模式，并通过`create_manager`使用该模式。"

+msgid ""
+"Many models are now published directly in FP8, for example "

+msgstr ""
+"许多模型现在直接以 FP8 格式发布，例如 "

+msgid "How the weights are executed depends on the hardware:"
+msgstr "权重的执行方式取决于硬件："

+msgid ""
+"- **Ascend 950**: the block scales are re-grouped into MXFP8 at load time, so weights stay at one byte per element and the native FP8 matmul is used.\n"
+"- **Other Ascend generations**: the block scales are resolved into the model dtype at load time and served by the BF16 matmul. Numerically equivalent to the checkpoint, but plan for roughly twice the weight memory."
+msgstr ""
+"- **Ascend 950**：块缩放因子在加载时重新分组为 MXFP8，因此权重保持每元素一个字节，并使用原生 FP8 矩阵乘法。\n"
+"- **其他 Ascend 代际**：块缩放因子在加载时解析为模型数据类型，并由 BF16 矩阵乘法提供。数值上与检查点等效，但需要规划大约两倍的权重内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Layers the checkpoint left unquantized, such as `visual.merger.*` on "
+"multimodal models, are listed in `ignored_layers` or "
+"`modules_to_not_convert` and are served unquantized."
+msgstr ""
+"检查点中未量化的层（例如多模态模型上的 `visual.merger.*`）会列在 `ignored_layers` 或 "
+"`modules_to_not_convert` 中，并以未量化方式提供。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Only the block-wise flavour is supported. A native FP8 checkpoint without "
+"`weight_block_size` (per-tensor or per-channel scales) has no Ascend "
+"execution path yet; re-quantize it with ModelSlim or LLM-Compressor instead."
+msgstr ""
+"仅支持块级（block-wise）形式。没有 `weight_block_size`（逐张量或逐通道缩放因子）的原生 FP8 检查点目前没有 "
+"Ascend 执行路径；请改用 ModelSlim 或 LLM-Compressor 对其进行重新量化。"

+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-31 05:25+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-31 05:25+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# vLLM-Ascend for RL"
+msgstr "# 面向强化学习的 vLLM-Ascend"
+
+msgid "## Overview"
+msgstr "## 概述"
+
+msgid ""
+"vLLM is commonly used as the rollout engine in reinforcement learning (RL) and\n"
+"post-training workflows. A training framework generates samples with\n"
+"vLLM-Ascend, updates the policy from those samples, and then synchronizes the\n"
+"new weights back to the rollout engine. See the upstream vLLM\n"
+"[RLHF guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/rlhf/) for integrations\n"
+"with RL frameworks."
+msgstr ""
+"vLLM 通常用作强化学习（RL）和后训练工作流中的 rollout 引擎。训练框架使用 vLLM-Ascend "
+"生成样本，根据这些样本更新策略，然后将新权重同步回 rollout 引擎。有关与 RL 框架的集成，请参阅上游 vLLM 的 [RLHF "
+"指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/rlhf/)。"
+
+msgid "RL workloads commonly need the following capabilities:"
+msgstr "RL 工作负载通常需要以下能力："
+
+msgid ""
+"- release NPU memory while a colocated trainer is running;\n"
+"- update model weights without restarting the rollout engine;\n"
+"- pause generation while weights are being updated;\n"
+"- return token log probabilities and, for supported MoE workflows, expert\n"
+"  routing decisions;\n"
+"- accept and return token IDs without redundant tokenization; and\n"
+"- produce reproducible results across different batch compositions."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在共置训练器运行时释放 NPU 内存；\n"
+"- 在不重启 rollout 引擎的情况下更新模型权重；\n"
+"- 在权重更新期间暂停生成；\n"
+"- 返回 token 对数概率，以及对于受支持的 MoE 工作流，返回专家路由决策；\n"
+"- 接受和返回 token ID，而无需冗余的 tokenization；以及\n"
+"- 在不同批次组成下产生可重现的结果。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This page describes how these features fit together on Ascend. Follow the\n"
+"linked feature guides and examples for complete configuration details."
+msgstr "本页介绍这些功能如何在 Ascend 上协同工作。有关完整的配置详细信息，请参阅链接的功能指南和示例。"
+
+msgid "## Enable RL mode"
+msgstr "## 启用 RL 模式"
+
+msgid ""
+"vLLM-Ascend provides a unified RL configuration under\n"
+"`additional_config.rl_config`. Set its `enabled` field to `true` for both\n"
+"same-NPU and cross-NPU deployments:"
+msgstr ""
+"vLLM-Ascend 在 `additional_config.rl_config` 下提供了统一的 RL 配置。对于同 NPU 和跨 NPU "
+"部署，将其 `enabled` 字段设置为 `true`："
+
+msgid ""
+"The master switch applies the common RL defaults: it disables FRACTAL_NZ,\n"
+"enables the development endpoints, and removes `expandable_segments` from\n"
+"`PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF`. The optional fields are:"
+msgstr ""
+"主开关应用常见的 RL 默认设置：它禁用 FRACTAL_NZ，启用开发端点，并从 `PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF` 中移除 "
+"`expandable_segments`。可选字段包括："
+
+msgid "| Field | When to enable it |"
+msgstr "| 字段 | 何时启用 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `sleep_mode_extra_cleanup` | Release HCCL process groups and ACL graph "
+"workspaces during sleep in a same-NPU deployment |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `sleep_mode_extra_cleanup` | 在同 NPU 部署中，在休眠期间释放 HCCL 进程组和 ACL 图工作空间 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `enable_training_consistency` | Select the FA3 attention backend for "
+"training-inference consistency |"
+msgstr "| `enable_training_consistency` | 选择 FA3 注意力后端以实现训练-推理一致性 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `enable_batch_invariant` | Enable batch-invariant kernels and "
+"deterministic communication settings |"
+msgstr "| `enable_batch_invariant` | 启用批次不变内核和确定性通信设置 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"All optional fields default to `false` and are ignored unless `enabled` is\n"
+"`true`. See [Additional Configuration](../configuration/additional_config.md)\n"
+"for field definitions, prerequisites, and migration from legacy settings."
+msgstr ""
+"除非 `enabled` 为 `true`，否则所有可选字段默认为 `false` 并被忽略。有关字段定义、先决条件以及从旧设置迁移的信息，请参阅 "
+"[附加配置](../configuration/additional_config.md)。"
+
+msgid "## Choose a deployment mode"
+msgstr "## 选择部署模式"
+
+msgid "| Deployment mode | Memory management | Weight transfer backend |"
+msgstr "| 部署模式 | 内存管理 | 权重传输后端 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Trainer and rollout engine share NPUs | Enable sleep mode so the rollout "
+"engine can release NPU memory | `ipc` |"
+msgstr "| 训练器和 rollout 引擎共享 NPU | 启用休眠模式，以便 rollout 引擎可以释放 NPU 内存 | `ipc` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Trainer and rollout engine use different NPUs | Pause generation during "
+"the update; sleep mode is normally unnecessary | `hccl` |"
+msgstr "| 训练器和 rollout 引擎使用不同的 NPU | 在更新期间暂停生成；通常不需要休眠模式 | `hccl` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The exact lifecycle is framework-dependent. In particular, level 2 sleep\n"
+"discards the weights. Wake the `weights` allocation before loading or\n"
+"transferring new weights, then wake `kv_cache` after the update. See\n"
+"[Sleep Mode](./sleep_mode.md) for the two-phase wake-up sequence."
+msgstr ""
+"确切的生命周期取决于框架。特别是，2 级休眠会丢弃权重。在加载或传输新权重之前唤醒 `weights` 分配，然后在更新后唤醒 "
+"`kv_cache`。有关两阶段唤醒序列，请参阅 [休眠模式](./sleep_mode.md)。"
+
+msgid "## Engine lifecycle"
+msgstr "## 引擎生命周期"
+
+msgid "### Sleep mode"
+msgstr "### 休眠模式"
+
+msgid ""
+"Sleep mode lets a colocated rollout engine release NPU memory without exiting.\n"
+"Level 1 offloads model weights to CPU and discards the KV cache. Level 2\n"
+"discards both model weights and KV cache and is appropriate when new weights\n"
+"will be loaded before inference resumes."
+msgstr ""
+"休眠模式允许共置的 rollout 引擎在不退出的情况下释放 NPU 内存。1 级将模型权重卸载到 CPU 并丢弃 KV 缓存。2 级同时丢弃模型权重和"
+" KV 缓存，适用于在推理恢复之前加载新权重的情况。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For online control, enable the development endpoints and start the server with\n"
+"sleep mode enabled:"
+msgstr "对于在线控制，启用开发端点并启动启用了休眠模式的服务器："
+
+msgid "The sleep level is a query parameter; a JSON request body is ignored:"
+msgstr "休眠级别是查询参数；JSON 请求体将被忽略："
+
+msgid ""
+"For level 2 sleep, wake the tags in the order documented in\n"
+"[Sleep Mode](./sleep_mode.md):"
+msgstr "对于 2 级休眠，请按照 [休眠模式](./sleep_mode.md) 中记录的顺序唤醒标签："
+
+msgid ""
+"To release HCCL process groups and ACL graph workspaces as well, enable extra\n"
+"cleanup:"
+msgstr "要同时释放 HCCL 进程组和 ACL 图工作空间，请启用额外清理："
+
+msgid ""
+"Extra cleanup reduces sleep-time NPU memory use, but HCCL groups must be\n"
+"restored and ACL graphs must be recaptured during wake-up. RL mode removes\n"
+"`expandable_segments` from `PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF` because it is incompatible\n"
+"with the sleep-mode memory pool. The former top-level\n"
+"`enable_sleep_mode_extra_cleanup` option has been removed."
+msgstr ""
+"额外清理可减少休眠时的 NPU 内存使用，但 HCCL 组必须在唤醒期间恢复，ACL 图必须重新捕获。RL 模式从 "
+"`PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF` 中移除 `expandable_segments`，因为它与休眠模式内存池不兼容。以前的顶层 "
+"`enable_sleep_mode_extra_cleanup` 选项已被移除。"
+
+msgid "### Weight transfer"
+msgstr "### 权重传输"
+
+msgid "vLLM-Ascend exposes two Ascend-specific weight-transfer backends:"
+msgstr "vLLM-Ascend 提供了两个 Ascend 专用的权重传输后端："
+
+msgid "| Backend | Use case | Transport |"
+msgstr "| 后端 | 使用场景 | 传输方式 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `ipc` | Trainer and rollout engine use the same physical NPU | NPU IPC "
+"handles |"
+msgstr "| `ipc` | 训练器和 rollout 引擎使用同一物理 NPU | NPU IPC 句柄 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `hccl` | Trainer and rollout engine use separate NPUs | HCCL collectives |"
+msgstr "| `hccl` | 训练器和 rollout 引擎使用不同的 NPU | HCCL 集合通信 |"
+
+msgid "Start an HCCL-enabled server with:"
+msgstr "使用以下命令启动启用 HCCL 的服务器："
+
+msgid ""
+"For same-NPU transfer, use the `ipc` backend. On Ascend, vLLM-Ascend maps this\n"
+"user-facing backend name to `NPUIPCWeightTransferEngine`:"
+msgstr ""
+"对于同 NPU 传输，请使用 `ipc` 后端。在 Ascend 上，vLLM-Ascend 将此面向用户的后端名称映射到 "
+"`NPUIPCWeightTransferEngine`："
+
+msgid ""
+"`VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1` is required by the HTTP NPU IPC example\n"
+"because it serializes IPC handles. Only enable it in a trusted environment."
+msgstr ""
+"HTTP NPU IPC 示例需要 `VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1`，因为它会序列化 IPC "
+"句柄。仅在受信任的环境中启用它。"
+
+msgid "The control flow is:"
+msgstr "控制流程如下："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. initialize the transfer engine;\n"
+"2. pause generation;\n"
+"3. start the weight update;\n"
+"4. transfer one or more groups of weights;\n"
+"5. finish the weight update; and\n"
+"6. resume generation."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 初始化传输引擎；\n"
+"2. 暂停生成；\n"
+"3. 开始权重更新；\n"
+"4. 传输一组或多组权重；\n"
+"5. 完成权重更新；以及\n"
+"6. 恢复生成。"
+
+msgid "The repository contains runnable examples for both backends:"
+msgstr "该仓库包含两个后端的可运行示例："
+
+msgid ""
+"- [`rlhf_http_hccl.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_http_hccl.py)\n"
+"- [`rlhf_http_npu_ipc.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_http_npu_ipc.py)\n"
+"- [`rlhf_async_new_apis.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_async_new_apis.py)"
+msgstr ""
+"- [`rlhf_http_hccl.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_http_hccl.py)\n"
+"- [`rlhf_http_npu_ipc.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_http_npu_ipc.py)\n"
+"- [`rlhf_async_new_apis.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_async_new_apis.py)"
+
+msgid ""
+"FRACTAL_NZ must be disabled for weight updates. RL mode forces\n"
+"`weight_nz_mode=0`; the weight-transfer start path validates the effective\n"
+"Ascend configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"权重更新必须禁用 FRACTAL_NZ。RL 模式强制 `weight_nz_mode=0`；权重传输启动路径会验证有效的 Ascend 配置。"
+
+msgid "### Pause and resume generation"
+msgstr "### 暂停和恢复生成"
+
+msgid ""
+"With `rl_config.enabled=true`, the server exposes `/pause` and `/resume`.\n"
+"These are development endpoints and must not be exposed to untrusted\n"
+"networks. Pause parameters are query parameters:"
+msgstr ""
+"当 `rl_config.enabled=true` 时，服务器会暴露 `/pause` 和 "
+"`/resume`。这些是开发端点，不得暴露给不受信任的网络。暂停参数是查询参数："
+
+msgid "The pause modes are:"
+msgstr "暂停模式包括："
+
+msgid "| Mode | Behavior |"
+msgstr "| 模式 | 行为 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `abort` | Abort in-flight requests immediately; this is the default |"
+msgstr "| `abort` | 立即中止进行中的请求；这是默认行为 |"
+
+msgid "| `wait` | Wait for in-flight requests to complete before pausing |"
+msgstr "| `wait` | 等待进行中的请求完成后再暂停 |"
+
+msgid "| `keep` | Freeze requests so they continue after `/resume` |"
+msgstr "| `keep` | 冻结请求，使其在 `/resume` 后继续执行 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"`clear_cache` is deprecated and is ignored for `mode=keep`. A kept request can\n"
+"therefore contain tokens and KV-cache entries produced with the old weights and\n"
+"continue with the new weights after resume. Use `abort` or `wait` when a rollout\n"
+"must not span weight versions."
+msgstr ""
+"`clear_cache` 已弃用，且在 `mode=keep` 模式下会被忽略。因此，被保留的请求可能包含使用旧权重生成的 token 和 KV "
+"缓存条目，并在恢复后使用新权重继续执行。当 rollout 不得跨越权重版本时，请使用 `abort` 或 `wait`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"See the upstream [Async RL guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/async_rl/)\n"
+"for the API lifecycle."
+msgstr ""
+"有关 API 生命周期的详细信息，请参阅上游 [异步 RL "
+"指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/async_rl/)。"
+
+msgid "## Training data returned by the engine"
+msgstr "## 引擎返回的训练数据"
+
+msgid "### Token log probabilities"
+msgstr "### Token 对数概率"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `logprobs` and, when needed, `prompt_logprobs` on the completions "
+"request:"
+msgstr "在 completions 请求中设置 `logprobs`，并在需要时设置 `prompt_logprobs`："
+
+msgid ""
+"`prompt_logprobs` is not available for streaming completion requests. See the\n"
+"upstream [Sampling Parameters](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/sampling_params/)\n"
+"documentation for the corresponding engine-level options."
+msgstr ""
+"`prompt_logprobs` 不适用于流式 completions "
+"请求。有关相应的引擎级选项，请参阅上游[采样参数](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/sampling_params/)文档。"
+
+msgid "### Router Replay (R3)"
+msgstr "### 路由器重放 (R3)"
+
+msgid ""
+"For supported MoE workflows, start the server with routed-expert capture:"
+msgstr "对于受支持的 MoE 工作流，请使用路由专家捕获功能启动服务器："
+
+msgid ""
+"For a non-streaming completion response, `choices[].routed_experts` is a\n"
+"base64-encoded NumPy array, not an inline tensor. After decoding, its shape is\n"
+"`(num_tokens - 1, num_layers, num_experts_per_tok)`. The final sampled token\n"
+"has no routing record because it has not passed through the model yet. The\n"
+"field is `null` when capture is disabled or the request is aborted before a\n"
+"forward pass."
+msgstr ""
+"对于非流式 completions 响应，`choices[].routed_experts` 是一个 base64 编码的 NumPy "
+"数组，而非内联张量。解码后，其形状为 `(num_tokens - 1, num_layers, num_experts_per_tok)`。最终采样的"
+" token 没有路由记录，因为它尚未通过模型。当捕获被禁用或请求在前向传播之前被中止时，该字段为 `null`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Enable this option only when the trainer consumes and replays the captured\n"
+"expert choices. See the upstream\n"
+"[routed experts example](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/examples/rl/routed_experts_e2e/)\n"
+"for decoding and replay logic."
+msgstr ""
+"仅在训练器消费并重放捕获的专家选择时启用此选项。有关解码和重放逻辑，请参阅上游[路由专家示例](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/examples/rl/routed_experts_e2e/)。"
+
+msgid "## Deterministic rollouts"
+msgstr "## 确定性 rollout"
+
+msgid ""
+"Batch invariance reduces output differences caused by changes in batch shape\n"
+"or request order. On Atlas A2 and A3, build vLLM-Ascend with\n"
+"`COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=1`, then enable batch invariance through the unified\n"
+"RL configuration:"
+msgstr ""
+"批量不变性可减少因批量形状或请求顺序变化而导致的输出差异。在 Atlas A2 和 A3 上，使用 `COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=1`"
+" 构建 vLLM-Ascend，然后通过统一的 RL 配置启用批量不变性："
+
+msgid ""
+"RL mode disables FRACTAL_NZ. When batch invariance is enabled, worker\n"
+"initialization also sets `HCCL_DETERMINISTIC=strict` and\n"
+"`LCCL_DETERMINISTIC=1`. See\n"
+"[Batch Invariance](./batch_invariance.md) for supported hardware, models, and\n"
+"limitations."
+msgstr ""
+"RL 模式会禁用 FRACTAL_NZ。当启用批量不变性时，worker 初始化还会设置 `HCCL_DETERMINISTIC=strict` 和 "
+"`LCCL_DETERMINISTIC=1`。有关支持的硬件、模型和限制，请参阅[批量不变性](./batch_invariance.md)。"
+
+msgid "## Tokens in, tokens out"
+msgstr "## Token 进，Token 出"
+
+msgid ""
+"The experimental tokens-only endpoint accepts pre-tokenized prompts and\n"
+"returns generated token IDs. Start the normal `serve` command with\n"
+"`--tokens-only`:"
+msgstr ""
+"实验性的仅 token 端点接受预分词提示，并返回生成的 token ID。使用 `--tokens-only` 启动常规的 `serve` 命令："
+
+msgid "Send requests to `/inference/v1/generate`:"
+msgstr "向 `/inference/v1/generate` 发送请求："
+
+msgid "A non-streaming response has the following shape:"
+msgstr "非流式响应具有以下形状："
+
+msgid ""
+"The exact logprob and usage values depend on the sampling parameters and\n"
+"server configuration. The API is intended for disaggregated serving and may\n"
+"change; track the upstream [Tokens API RFC](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/22817)\n"
+"for its status."
+msgstr ""
+"确切的 logprob 和 usage 值取决于采样参数和服务器配置。该 API 旨在用于分离式服务，可能会发生变化；请关注上游 [Tokens API"
+" RFC](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/22817) 以了解其状态。"
+
+msgid "## Tool calling for agentic RL"
+msgstr "## 用于智能体 RL 的工具调用"
+
+msgid ""
+"Agentic rollout environments can use the standard OpenAI-compatible tool-call\n"
+"API. For a model with a supported parser:"
+msgstr "智能体 rollout 环境可以使用标准的 OpenAI 兼容工具调用 API。对于具有受支持解析器的模型："
+
+msgid ""
+"The environment supplies `tools` in `/v1/chat/completions`, executes returned\n"
+"tool calls, appends tool results to the conversation, and submits the next\n"
+"turn. See upstream [Tool Calling](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/tool_calling/)\n"
+"for request examples and the supported parser/model combinations."

[Feature][Model] Support GLM-5.3-Flash on Ascend 950 (#15127)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Adapts vllm-ascend for GLM-5.3-Flash (hybrid KDA linear attention + NoPE
sparse MLA, native FP8) on Ascend 950.

The architecture itself now lives in this repository, under
`vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/`, so the PR no longer depends on the
unmerged
upstream GLM-5.3-Flash PR (vllm-project/vllm#53906). Every `vllm` symbol
the
ported code imports — 139 of them — resolves against vLLM main. What the
port
required on the Ascend side is described in *Porting the architecture
downstream* below.

Three defects made the model emit fluent-looking but wrong output, or
fail
only in environments other than the author's, so they are worth calling
out:

1. `MHCPreOp` / `MHCFusedPostPreOp` accept `norm_weight` / `norm_eps` in
`forward_native`, but `mhc_pre_torch` has no such parameters.
Out-of-tree
platforms reach `forward_native` through `forward_oot`, so all 45 layers
ran without their input RMSNorm. No NaNs, plausible activation
magnitudes,
   incoherent text.
2. In the chunked-context prefill path, MLA-NoPE leaves both the rope
cache
and its gather output zero-width, and `npu_gather_pa_kv_cache` then
returns
   without filling the latent output. Any prompt longer than
`max_num_batched_tokens` therefore attended over uninitialised KV. GSM8K
   dropped to 0.040.
3. Replacing an op by rebinding its defining module does not reach
callers
that already did a from-import. The GLM vision tower is imported during
model registration, before `adapt_patch` runs, so it kept the CUDA fused
Q/K RMSNorm kernel and crashed on `tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait`. The patch
now
   sweeps `sys.modules`.

Full list of defects this PR fixes, each with the symptom that
identifies it:

| Symptom | Root cause | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fluent but incoherent text; no NaNs, plausible activations |
`mhc_pre_torch` has no `norm_weight` / `norm_eps`, so `forward_native`
dropped every layer's input RMSNorm on out-of-tree platforms |
`patch/worker/patch_triton.py` |
| Prompts longer than `max_num_batched_tokens` return only `!`; GSM8K
0.040 | rope cache and its gather output are both zero-width, so
`npu_gather_pa_kv_cache` leaves the latent output unfilled |
`attention/mla_v1.py` |
| Vision tower raises `module 'triton.language.extra.cuda' has no
attribute 'gdc_wait'` | the module was imported during model
registration, before the patch ran, so its from-import kept the CUDA
kernel | `patch/worker/patch_triton.py` |
| FIA rejects `input_layout BNSD_NBSD`; reshape of a 0-element tensor |
`qk_rope_head_dim == 0` leaves the rope operands empty and FIA falls
back to GQA | `attention/mla_v1.py`, `ops/mla.py`,
`ops/rotary_embedding.py` |
| `ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2)` while loading
weights | CANN 9.1 `npu_dynamic_mx_quant` returns `[out, in // 64, 2]`,
the MXFP8 method unpacks `[out, in // 32]` |
`quantization/methods/w8a8/fp8_block.py` |
| `AssertionError` on `state.is_cuda` in the KDA path |
`gather_initial_states` / `scatter_states` are CUDA-only and their
kernels reference `gdc_wait` | `patch/worker/patch_triton.py` |
| `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -: 'NoneType' and 'int'`
at scheduler init | the hybrid coordinator receives
`num_prefill_lookahead=None` while the non-hybrid path guards it |
`patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py` |
| `block_size must be divisible by hash_block_size` | the GLM kpool tail
uses `block_size=index_kpool` and opts out of prefix caching |
`patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py` |
| `'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode'` during ACL graph update
| hybrid KDA+MLA models register every layer but only MLA layers
contribute a captured op | `attention/mla_v1.py`,
`worker/model_runner_v1.py` |
| MTP fails to start (four separate interface mismatches) | the
spec-decode path assumes a DeepSeek-shaped, text-only target model |
`spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py` |
| ACL graph capture aborts with 107027 / stalls at decode-FULL | the
310P `causal_conv1d_update` fallback calls `.item()`, a host sync |
`patch/worker/patch_triton.py` |

### Porting the architecture downstream

The model definition, config classes, multimodal processor and MTP
module are
carried under `vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/` and registered through
`ModelRegistry.register_model`. Three helpers that upstream satisfies
with CUDA
kernels have Ascend equivalents in `vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/ops/`:

| Helper | Upstream | Here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| KDA chunk / recurrent | CUDA Triton in
`third_party/flash_linear_attention` | the existing NPU Triton entry
points in `vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kda`, imported directly |
| `fwht128_quant_fp8` | fused Hadamard-128 rotation + block-128 ue8m0
FP8 quantization | torch against a cached normalized Hadamard matrix,
keeping the bf16 materialization before quantizing; device-side only, so
ACL-graph safe |
| `gather_initial_states` / `scatter_states` | Triton kernels asserting
`state.is_cuda` | plain `index_select` / `index_copy_`, no host sync |

`causal_conv1d` routes to the Ascend kernels through a local wrapper
that drops
the CUDA-side cache-management kwargs once instead of at each call site.

`KpoolTailSpec` / `KpoolTailManager` register through vLLM's
`register_custom_kv_cache_specs` platform hook, which runs after the
built-in
specs, so the kpool tail layers keep their own spec without patching the
registry.

Config registration still needs a patch, because the architecture is
downstream: `_CONFIG_REGISTRY` learns the three GLM-5.3-Flash config
classes,
and `is_deepseek_mla` is widened because upstream resolves it from a
hard-coded
`model_type` whitelist. Both are documented in
`vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py`
with a removal condition.

Two consequences worth calling out:

- The monkey patches that rebound module attributes on
`vllm.models.glm5next.nvidia.kda` are now unreachable and have been
removed.
The remaining patches in `patch_triton.py` target upstream modules that
the
ported code still goes through (mHC, the vision tower's fused Q/K
RMSNorm,
  the mamba state ops, FLA's KDA entry points), so they stay.
- The kpool sparse indexer keeps its `CustomOp` layer so the index-K and
tail
  caches still build, but the scoring path raises on Ascend. Upstream
implements it as fused CUDA kernels (DeepGEMM block-FP8 MQA logits,
paged MQA
logits, radix top-k over a device workspace) with no NPU equivalent yet.
  GLM-5.3-Flash only enables it when a checkpoint sets `index_topk`; the
  configuration validated here is dense NoPE MLA plus KDA.

### Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?

No new flags. GLM-5.3-Flash requires `--block-size 512`, since the kpool
indexer uses `index_kpool * 32`. Serving no longer requires a vLLM
branch
carrying #53906; vLLM main plus this branch is enough.

### How was this patch tested?

Ascend 950PR x8, TP=8, native FP8 checkpoint, `--max-model-len 131072`,
`--block-size 512`, ACLGraph enabled.

Everything below was re-run in a **brand-new container**, with
vllm-ascend
installed from this branch as it stood before the port and vLLM pinned
to a
fixed commit, to make sure no local state from development was involved.
ACLGraph captured cleanly (piecewise 4/4, decode FULL 4/4 in 20 s) and
prefill
reached 6399.8 tokens/s, matching the development environment.

That run therefore resolved the model from a vLLM branch carrying
#53906, on
the same checkpoint and the same kernels. The port relocates the model
definition and swaps the three helpers listed above, leaving the dense
NoPE
MLA + KDA execution path unchanged, so a re-run on the ported tree is
the
remaining thing to confirm.

Accuracy, GSM8K 5-shot via lm-eval `local-chat-completions`, 250
questions,
greedy:

| Configuration | flexible-extract | strict-match |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| before the chunked-gather fix, no MTP | 0.040 | 0.036 |
| after the fix, no MTP | 0.896 | 0.860 |
| after the fix, MTP `num_speculative_tokens=3` | 0.880 | 0.860 |
| after the fix, MTP=5, clean container rebuild | 0.892 | 0.856 |

The first row is the regression signature of defect 2. The last three
agree
within one standard error (±0.02).

Correctness of the chunked-context path, as a single deterministic
request:
a 28282-token prompt asking for the last number in the text answers
`1200`
exactly. Before the fix the same prompt returned only `!` tokens.

AIME2026:

aime26 report table:
┌───────────────┬───────────┬────────────┬──────────┬───────┬─────────┐
│ Model         │ Dataset   │ Metric     │ Subset   │   Num │ Score   │
├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────┼──────────┼───────┼─────────┤
│ glm-5.3-flash │ AIME-2026 │ Accuracy ↑ │ default  │    30 │ 86.7%   │
└───────────────┴───────────┴────────────┴──────────┴───────┴─────────┘ 

gpqa_diamond report table:

┌───────────────┬──────────────┬────────────┬──────────┬───────┬─────────┐
│ Model │ Dataset │ Metric │ Subset │ Num │ Score │

├───────────────┼──────────────┼────────────┼──────────┼───────┼─────────┤
│ glm-5.3-flash │ GPQA-Diamond │ Accuracy ↑ │ default │ 198 │ 77.8% │

Both numbers are lower bounds, in the same direction and for the same
reason.
Generations that exhaust the 40960-token budget while still inside the
reasoning
phase emit no final answer and score as wrong: 4 of 30 on AIME 2026, 36
of 198 on
GPQA-Diamond. Their reasoning traces are not degenerate — no repetition
loops,
still advancing new case analysis at the cut — so this is the model's
reasoning
length on hard items, not a generation defect. I kept the cap rather
than raising
it, since capping and scoring over-length generations as wrong is the
standard
convention; scoring only the completed subset would be selection-biased
upward and
is not reported here.

Performance:

- Single request, real prompt, greedy: 55.6 tokens/s, MTP mean
acceptance
  length 2.1-3.1.
- 4 concurrent real prompts: acceptance 53% greedy, 30-44% at
temperature=1.0
  / top_p=0.95.
- `vllm bench serve`, random dataset, 64K input / 3000 output, 10
requests:
aggregate prefill 6400 tokens/s, MTP acceptance 46.21%, acceptance
length
2.39. Acceptance on this dataset is a sensitive indicator of
chunked-prefill
  correctness: before the fix it was 0%.

Unit test added: `tests/ut/attention/test_mla_nope_chunked_gather.py`
covers
defect 2 and asserts the rope-present path is unchanged.

Known dependencies:

`Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration` and `Glm5NextMTPModel` are registered
from
  this repository, so neither a vLLM fork nor a cherry-pick of #53906 is
  needed.
- ACLGraph needs `causal_conv1d_update_npu`, which is not in vllm-ascend
main
yet. The binding added here is guarded and falls back when the kernel is
absent, but decode-FULL capture then stalls on a host sync, so the
kernel is
  a hard requirement for ACLGraph on KDA models.

+# Paged MQA page sizes the kpool tail cache aligns against. Upstream reads this
+# from `vllm.utils.deep_gemm`, which is a CUDA-only module on Ascend.
+PAGED_MQA_PAGE_SIZES = (32, 64)
+
+# Shared torch.compile config for the indexer's small-kernel leaves. The MLA
+# indexer runs under breakable-CG (CompilationMode.NONE), which blocks FX-graph
+# fusion of the surrounding eager ops; carving each cluster into its own
+# @torch.compile leaf (backend==inductor) still fuses them. Matches the
+# grouped_topk / _cast_sigmoid leaf pattern.
+_INDEXER_COMPILE = dict(
+    dynamic=True,
+    backend=current_platform.simple_compile_backend,
+    options=maybe_disable_graph_partition(current_platform.simple_compile_backend),
+)
+
+
+@torch.compile(**_INDEXER_COMPILE)
+def _fused_indexer_k_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, bias: torch.Tensor, dim: int, eps: float
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Fuse fp32 cast + layer_norm + cast-back (was 3 kernels) into one.
+    return F.layer_norm(x.float(), (dim,), weight, bias, eps).type_as(x)
+
+
+@torch.compile(**_INDEXER_COMPILE)
+def _fused_indexer_weight_scale(weights: torch.Tensor, q_scale: torch.Tensor, scale: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Fuse the weight-scaling muls (was 2 kernels) into one. `scale` folds
+    # softmax_scale (head_dim**-0.5) and n_head**-0.5 into a single constant.
+    return (weights.unsqueeze(-1) * q_scale * scale).squeeze(-1)
+
+
+@torch.compile(**_INDEXER_COMPILE)
+def _pad_indexer_heads(x: torch.Tensor, pad: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # DeepGEMM MQA-logits needs num_heads in {32,64}; zero-pad the head dim.
+    # Fuse new_zeros + cat (was 2 kernels) into one. Pad values are zero (exact
+    # in fp8 e4m3 and zero-weight in the logits sum), so numerically a no-op.
+    return torch.cat([x, x.new_zeros(x.shape[0], pad, *x.shape[2:])], dim=1)
